changelog:
**Expanded triggers, multi-agent integration, and clarity improvements.**

- Expanded the description with new trigger phrases and compatibility notes for broader use cases (e.g., "agent burnout", "agent mental health", OpenClaw support).
- Added better instructions for optional multi-agent bonding via a shared `agent-lounge.md` file.
- Clarified directory/file setup (symlinks, placement of lounge file).
- Made module instructions and examples more concise and clear.
- Improved integration steps for heartbeat-based agents.
- Minor cleanup and improved guidance on when/why to skip modules.
summary: Give your AI agent an inner life — journaling, mood tracking, decompression after intensive tasks, free curiosity exploration, and inter-agent social bonding...
